[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:386YE Spring]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Announced by Vivane Knotes, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave">As bearer of the First Imperial Wayleave, I hereby announce the commission of a 16 wain mana ministry in Happiston in the Marches. This will create a Marcher National title called "The Reeve of the Happiston Mana Exchange" to be annually elected by a Tally of the Votes. Costs to be covered in entirety by "Morgan Townsend" through the Prosperity of Happiston Bakes.</quote>
==Overview==
* Creates a ministry in Chalkdowns, [[Mournwold]] that allows the purchase of mana crystals 
* Announcement by the [[Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]]
==Date==
* Spring 386YE
==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 16 mithril
* 48 crowns
* Three months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Happiston_Mana_Exchange}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete, the [[Reeve of the Happiston Mana Exchange]] will be available to elect by Tally of the Votes of Marcher [[farm]] owners for the first time at the Summer Solstice 386YE for a short term until the Winter Solstice 386YE.
